heading: SEBI Bars Avadhut Sathe, Academy; Imposes ₹11.5 Crore Penalty
tldr: The market regulator SEBI has permanently barred Avadhut Dinkar Sathe and his academy, ASTAPL, from the securities market.
They have been directed to disgorge and refund ₹546.17 crore to investors who paid for their unregistered investment advisory services.
A separate penalty of ₹11.5 crore has also been imposed on Avadhut Sathe and ASTAPL.
This action underscores SEBI's firm stance against entities providing investment advice without proper registration.
Investors are strongly advised to always verify the SEBI registration of any financial advisor before engaging their services.
caption:
Here's a heads-up for anyone getting financial advice! India's market watchdog, SEBI, has taken strong action against an individual and their academy for giving investment tips without being officially registered. They now have to pay back a huge sum to investors. This reminds us how important it is to always check if your financial advisor is properly registered with SEBI. Don't risk your hard-earned money!
